name: com.ahmetaydin.localtts
description: Fully local, on-device text-to-speech for game characters. Kokoro-82M running on Unity Inference Engine — no cloud, no API keys, license-clean for commercial games.

samples.description: One component, one line: the minimal setup to make a character speak.
Two characters with distinct voices holding a queued conversation, with interrupt/barge-in.
